privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.notPublishedBody: This store has not published its privacy notice. Checkout is unavailable until it does.
privacy.adminDescription: Publish a notice customers can read before entering checkout details.
privacy.approvalGuidance: Enter text approved for this store. Include the controller, purposes, data categories, recipients, retention approach, customer rights and a working contact. This form does not draft legal wording, determine your legal basis, or file cross-border transfer assessments. Each publication creates an immutable version and immediately makes it current.
privacy.checkoutRequirement: Both Vietnamese and English versions must be published before checkout is enabled. When a customer consents to place an order, the order records the notice version and consent time. This does not prove that the customer opened or read the notice, and it does not extend consent to advertising, analytics or other purposes.
privacy.requiredBothLanguages: Both approved translations are required; each must contain 30 to 20,000 characters.

customerDetail.description: Order history and personal-data request handling for one customer.
customerDetail.duplicatePhoneWarning: Another customer in this store has the same phone number. Records are identified by email and are never merged.
customerDetail.anonymizeInstructions: Use only after verifying the requester and reviewing applicable retention requirements. This permanently removes contact and delivery details from this store, redacts stored payment webhook payloads, and keeps order/payment facts and audit history. It does not erase backups or copies held by processors.
customerDetail.identityConfirmation: I verified the requester's identity and reviewed the legal basis for retaining any transaction records.
customerDetail.valueDisclaimer: Order value is not settled revenue: it can include unpaid orders, and the store cannot confirm that funds reached a bank account.
customerDetail.noOrdersHint: This customer record has no orders in this store.
customerDetail.cancelledNote: Cancelled — excluded from this customer's order value.

orders.namePhoneDisclaimer: Both name and phone must match exactly what you gave at checkout — this is a stronger check than email alone, since a name or phone number by itself isn't unique enough to prove it's really your order.

admin.overviewDescription: A read-only snapshot of this store. Nothing on this page changes any data.
admin.bannerDesktopHelp: JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 8 MB. Recommended 2520×1080 (21:9), minimum 1680×720. Keep the main content within the middle ~80% of the width. Images are optimized and stored as WebP.
admin.bannerMobileHelp: A separate crop for smaller screens, also 21:9. If empty, the desktop image is used. Images are optimized and stored as WebP.
admin.bannerExistingImageNote: Previously uploaded images are not recropped automatically; replace an image to use the new 21:9 frame.
admin.cancelledNote: Cancelled orders are counted here but excluded from order value, which is why the two figures can move apart.
